name: Darwinbox
description_en:
Darwinbox is an enterprise HCM platform connecting Core HR with payroll, talent, workforce management and analytics. Its current Core HR page describes effective-dated employee records, complex organization structures, no-code workflows and integrations; the wider homepage separately introduces Cortex with an early-access call to action.

A buyer should distinguish an established Core HR workflow from the availability and commercial terms of new AI offerings. This draft uses rendered official pages because the direct text reader exposed only a small JavaScript shell, and makes no claim that a tenant or enterprise implementation was tested.
description_zh:
Darwinbox 是连接 Core HR、工资、人才、人员运营和分析的企业 HCM 平台。当前 Core HR 页描述按生效日期保存的员工数据、复杂组织结构、无代码流程及集成，更广首页则单独以早期访问入口介绍 Cortex。

买家需区分 Core HR 流程与新 AI 产品的可用性及商务条件。本稿依据渲染后的官方页面，因为直接文本读取仅显示少量 JavaScript 外壳，未声称测试过租户或企业实施。

core_features.explanation_en: Core HR describes organization, position, location, project and cost-center hierarchies, concurrent roles and scenario planning.
core_features.explanation_zh: Core HR 描述组织、岗位、地点、项目及成本中心层级、兼任角色和情景规划。

core_features.name_zh: 按生效日期管理的员工档案
core_features.explanation_en: Maintain lifecycle records, assignments, skills, policy documents and maker-checker or e-sign support.
core_features.explanation_zh: 维护生命周期、任职、技能、政策文档，并提供经办复核和电子签名支持。

core_features.explanation_en: The product page describes no-code approvals and a simulator for approvals, exceptions and outcomes before rollout.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品页描述无代码审批，以及上线前检查审批、异常和结果的模拟器。

pricing.summary_en: Customized modular quote required. No numeric Core HR rate, minimum term, implementation fee or universal AI entitlement verified.
pricing.summary_zh: 需要模块化定制报价，未核实 Core HR 金额、最短期限、实施费或普遍 AI 权益。

sections.title_en: Model the organization before migrating employees
sections.title_zh: 迁移员工前先建立组织模型
sections.en: Core HR describes organization, position, location, project and cost-center hierarchies, with job-based, position-based and hybrid workforce models. Its scenario-planning feature models organizational changes and policy or cost impact before approval. An illustrative transfer could move an employee between cost centers while preserving the effective-dated assignment and reporting line. Confirm how concurrent roles, country policies and historical reporting interact; a hierarchy demo does not prove every payroll consequence. Existing records and opening balances need reconciliation against the authoritative source before a migration is accepted.
sections.zh: Core HR 描述组织、岗位、地点、项目及成本中心层级，并支持按工作、岗位及混合人员模型。情景规划可在批准前建模组织变化及政策或成本影响。调动示例可让员工转成本中心，同时保留按生效日期的任职及汇报关系。需确认兼任角色、国家政策与历史报表如何交互，层级演示不能证明所有工资后果。迁移验收前仍需对照权威来源核对旧档案和期初余额。

sections.title_en: Use the simulator to inspect an exception
sections.en: The page describes preconfigured employee and manager self-service actions, approvals through channels such as email or Teams, AI-assisted workflow creation and a flow simulator. A useful demonstration would send a promotion through maker-checker review, then remove an approver or reject the action and inspect the result before rollout. These are proposed acceptance cases, not executed tests. AI-generated flows should be reviewed against company policy and permissions; neither automatic creation nor a simulation establishes that a production workflow is legally correct or immune to failure.
sections.zh: 页面描述预配置员工和经理自助操作、邮件或 Teams 等渠道审批、AI 辅助创建流程及流程模拟器。演示可让晋升进入经办复核，再移除审批人或拒绝操作，并在上线前检查结果。这些是拟议验收案例，不是实测。AI 生成流程需对照企业政策和权限审查，自动创建和模拟均不能证明生产流程法律正确或不会失败。

sections.title_en: Separate the shared core from licensed modules
sections.title_zh: 区分共享核心与模块许可
sections.en: Darwinbox says Core HR connects with its Payroll, Recruitment, Talent, Performance, Time & Attendance and People Analytics, as well as external systems through APIs and Darwinbox Studio. The page also describes SSO/SCIM and webhooks. Treat these as integration capabilities to scope by destination, data direction and purchased modules, not evidence that all modules are included. Its global localization, language and certification claims are vendor statements; this research did not audit country-specific payroll filings, security reports or a particular language interface. Core data localization is not the same as universal payroll service.
sections.zh: Darwinbox 称 Core HR 可连接自身工资、招聘、人才、绩效、工时考勤、人员分析，也可通过 API 和 Darwinbox Studio 连接外部系统，页面还描述 SSO/SCIM 和 webhook。应按目标、数据方向及所购模块明确这些能力，不能视为所有模块均已包含。全球本地化、语言及认证说法属于供应商声明，本研究未审计具体国家工资申报、安全报告或某种语言界面；核心数据本地化不等于普遍工资服务。

sections.title_en: Request a modular quote and a rollout scope
sections.title_zh: 取得模块化报价和实施范围
sections.en: The official quote page asks buyers to choose business needs for a customized modular HRMS proposal. No numeric subscription rate, minimum term or implementation amount was published in the read pages. A Core HR FAQ discusses a per-employee monthly model specifically under a People Analytics pricing question; it should not be generalized into a confirmed universal Core HR billing rule. Request module entitlements, headcount, regions, interfaces, AI usage, migration, training and support together. Implementation timing is described as dependent on size, complexity and scope, not a fixed guaranteed duration. A demo or early-access invitation is not a sustained free plan.
sections.zh: 官方询价页按业务需求提供模块化 HRMS 定制方案，所读页面未公开订阅金额、最短期限或实施费。Core HR FAQ 中每员工月度模式出现在 People Analytics 定价问题下，不能泛化为已确认的 Core HR 通用计费规则。需一并询价模块权益、人数、地区、接口、AI 用量、迁移、培训和支持。实施时间依赖规模、复杂度和范围，不是固定保证期限；演示或早期访问入口也不是长期免费套餐。

sections.title_en: Confirm the AI generation and contract actually offered
sections.title_zh: 确认实际提供的 AI 版本和合同
sections.en: The homepage introduces Cortex with early access, while the Core HR page also refers to Sapien and existing HR capabilities. These pages do not establish that every customer has already migrated to one identical AI edition. Confirm the product generation, availability and billable AI functions in the proposal. Darwinbox is most relevant for enterprises with complex structures and coordinated HR processes; a small team needing a basic directory should weigh the implementation effort. No workflow, data import, AI action or integration was executed. Hosting jurisdiction, retention, complete exports, failure recovery, contractual AI limits and source-code licensing remain unverified.
sections.zh: 首页以早期访问介绍 Cortex，而 Core HR 页还提及 Sapien 及既有 HR 能力。这些页面不能证明所有客户都已迁移到同一 AI 版本，需在方案中确认产品代际、可用性及收费 AI 功能。组织结构复杂且需协同 HR 流程的企业更值得评估 Darwinbox，仅需基础通讯录的小团队应衡量实施投入。未实际执行流程、导入、AI 或集成；托管辖区、保留期限、完整导出、失败恢复、合同 AI 上限和源代码许可仍未核实。
